common.tagline: Two days with the people who grow your food
common.demoNote: No Supabase project is connected, so this build is reading seed data and writing nothing. Add the keys in .env.example to switch to the real database.
common.poweredBy: One database, two portals, three languages.

hero.title: Two days in the fields of someone who grows what you eat.
hero.sub: Farm stays run by families who have finished onboarding — land seen, rooms photographed, a phone number that answers. Book a ready two-day trip, or build your own in four questions.

regions.title: Two vibhags, two weathers
regions.sub: A Kokan weekend and a Nashik weekend are not the same trip. Pick the one your month suits — or let the planner pick.

explore.title: Farms already on Connect to Nature
explore.sub: Every host here has finished onboarding: land papers seen, rooms photographed, a page written in all three languages.
explore.none: No farm matches that yet. Widen the budget, or try the other vibhag.

listing.includedList: One night in the room shown, four home-cooked meals, drinking water, every farm activity listed, and a pick-up from the nearest stand.
listing.noReviews: No reviews yet — this farm was onboarded recently.
listing.farmerKeeps: 92% of what you pay reaches the family.

packages.title: Ready two-day trips
packages.sub: A stay, the meals, and the activities already arranged with the family. One tap to ask for it.

planner.title: Build your two days
planner.sub: Four questions. We match a farm that is already onboarded and lay both days out hour by hour.
planner.q1: Where do you want to wake up?
planner.q1sub: The coast, the plateau, or whichever fits your other answers.
planner.q2sub: Two days and one night. Groups above eight are split across two houses on the same farm.
planner.q3: What would make it a good two days?
planner.q3sub: Pick as many as you like — the itinerary is built from these.
planner.q4sub: Per person, for the whole two days, meals included.
planner.noMatch: Nothing matches that combination yet — try a wider budget, or the other vibhag.
planner.matchRegion: in the vibhag you asked for

fixed.arriveNote: The family meets you at the stand and walks you round the land.
fixed.lunch1: Lunch, the way the house eats it
fixed.lunch1Note: Cooked on wood, served on the floor of the front room.
fixed.dinner1Note: Whatever came off the land that day, and the stories with it.
fixed.sleepNote: The generator, if there is one, goes off. It gets very quiet.
fixed.breakfast: Breakfast after the first round of work
fixed.breakfastNote: Poha or bhakri, and tea you will think about later.
fixed.lunch2Note: You leave with a bag of whatever is in season.

how.title: How it works
how.s1sub: Vibhag, group, what you like, what you want to spend. The planner does the matching.
how.s2: Pay, and the family calls you
how.s2sub: Within a day, in your language. You settle the dates and anything you cannot eat.
how.s3: You arrive and follow the routine
how.s3sub: Nobody performs for you. You get the day the family was going to have anyway.

trips.title: My trips
trips.reviewThanks: Thank you — your review is on the farm's page.
trips.reviewOnlyCompleted: You can review a stay once it is finished.

host.heroTitle: Your farm. Your price. Your phone number.
host.heroSub: Put your farm on Connect to Nature. Travellers arrive with the plan already agreed, and 92% of what they pay reaches you.
host.p1sub: And you keep 92% of it. No commission on your first ten bookings.
host.p2sub: Written from a conversation, not a form. You approve it before it goes up.
host.p3sub: They have already seen the plan, the food, and what the two days cost.
host.p4sub: Payout to your UPI or bank within three days of the guest leaving.
host.leadSub: Our field team for your vibhag will call you. Keep your 7/12 extract ready — that is the only paper we need.
host.name: Your name
host.leadDoneBody: Our team will call you on {phone}. Reference {code}.
host.farmDescription: Tell a traveller what the two days are like
host.photosNote: Rooms, kitchen, the land, and the way in. Four is enough.
host.submittedBody: Our team checks new farms within two working days. We will call you on {phone}.
host.noBookings: No bookings yet. Your page goes live once approved.
host.openDatesNote: Tap a date to open or close it. Guests can only ask for open dates.

footer.line: Built for the farming families of the Kokan and Nashik vibhags.
footer.demo: Farms, hosts and reviews on this build are written for the demo. The database, the row-level security, the planner and the booking flow are real.

credits.title: Where these pictures were actually taken
credits.intro: Every photograph on this site is a real photograph of Maharashtra, reused from Wikimedia Commons under a licence that allows it. Most of those licences ask for the photographer's name and a link, which is what this page is for.
credits.placeNote: The farms and the hosts on this build are written for the demo; the landscapes are not. A picture filed under a farm in Pawas may have been taken at Vengurla, so each credit names the place in the frame rather than the farm it illustrates.
credits.inReel: Also one of the six frames in the front-page reel.

mango.body: Wadis of mango on red laterite above the Ratnagiri coast, picked by hand from April.

paddy.body: Terraced rice in the Kokan hills, planted in the rain and cut by October.

cove.lead: The sea at the end of the lane.
cove.body: Coves like Aare Ware, where the road runs out and the water is warm.

falls.body: Jawhar in July, when every stream on the plateau finds an edge to fall off.

vines.body: Nashik's vineyards on black soil, a short drive from the Sahyadri.

lake.body: The reservoirs around Igatpuri, quiet enough to hear the far bank.

closer.title: The Kokan, before the day-trippers arrive.
closer.sub: Early light on the shore, the boats already back, and nowhere you need to be until lunch.

story.statement: No resort. No script. A family that grows mangoes, rice or grapes opens two ordinary days of its life to you — and 92% of what you pay reaches them.

day.title: Two days, hour by hour.
day.sub: Nobody performs for you. This is roughly what a Kokan farm day already looks like.

t1.label: Mist
t1.body: The hills are still inside the cloud. Tea on the verandah while the cows are milked.

t2.label: Orchard
t2.body: Into the wadi with whoever is working it — picking, grafting or carrying water, depending on the month.

t3.label: Shore
t3.body: Down to the sea for the last hour of light, the way the village goes after work.

t4.label: Dinner
t4.body: Back at the house for what the kitchen made of the day: fish, rice, kokum, and whatever was ripe.

look.title: Take a closer look.
look.label: A closer look at a farm stay

vibhag.label: Vibhag
vibhag.title: Two vibhags.
vibhag.body: The Kokan is laterite, mango and the sea. Nashik is black soil, vines and the edge of the Sahyadri.

land.label: The land
land.title: A working farm.
land.body: Not a garden kept for guests. You go out with whoever is working that day — ploughing, planting or picking — and help if you want to.

house.label: The house
house.title: Where you sleep.
house.body: A room in the family's own house or right beside it: thick laterite walls, a tiled roof and a verandah to sit out on.

food.label: The food
food.title: What was ripe.
food.body: Meals come from what the farm and the village grew that week — cashew and kokum on the coast, grapes and onions inland.

water.label: The water
water.title: Never far from it.
water.body: A cove, a reservoir, or a stream that turns into a waterfall in July. Both vibhags keep water within reach.

checked.label: Checked hosts
checked.title: Seen before listed.
checked.body: Every host has finished onboarding: land papers seen, rooms photographed, and a page written in all three languages.

pay.label: Fair pay
pay.title: 92% reaches the family.
pay.body: Pay by UPI, card or netbanking. The platform keeps 8%, and the rest goes to the family who hosted you.

film.label: Connect to Nature — a fifteen-second film
film.mapTitle: Two vibhags, a day's drive from Mumbai.

payments.demoNote: Sample rows — no database is connected.
